name: North-South Lake Campground
evidence: Esri leaf-off z19 42.2010,-74.0360 (0.2 m/px): gravel drive-in pads with tables on the North Lake NE-shore loop ~12-16 m from the high-water edge across open ground; matches --AWH 'some campsites are on the lake'; RA 'Near Water - no' is a weak booking tag

name: Brookside Beach Campground
evidence: Esri 42.3192,-79.6358: RV rows between Rt 5 and Lake Erie atop a ~20 m shale bluff (DEM 192-194 m vs lake 174 m); front sites ~20-40 m back from the cliff edge over open lawn -> view, climb-down to beach, not lakefront; pin moved from pond field onto RV rows

name: Taughannock Falls State Park
evidence: Esri 42.5428,-76.6061: camp loops on wooded slope south of Rt 89, ~150-280 m from Cayuga Lake with the highway and continuous woods between; creek runs in a deep gorge east of the loops; RA 'overlook' prose and 'Near Water - no' tags decide nothing

name: Massena International Kampground
evidence: operator 2024 site map: river-side sites 68-84 back onto a drawn treeline then grass to the Grasse River; NYS leaf-off ortho 44.9582,-74.8275: NE-edge pads ~60-70 m from the river behind a tree row and reed meadow, east-loop pads ~110 m back through woods, N tip held by private houses

name: North Bay Campground
evidence: NYS/Esri leaf-off 43.3146,-76.4410: front-row trailers ~25-45 m from Lake Neatahwanta with the shore camp lane between them and the beach; other rows upslope under woods; city 'waterfront sites' is prose with no per-site map -> lakeview

name: Paradox Lake Campground
evidence: RA site map (getSVGFragment, parkId 619): nearest sites 047-049 ~50+ m from the drawn shoreline, launch and beach lots hold the shore; matches DEC map; NYS ortho 43.8860,-73.6782 canopy-blind, no shore pads visible

name: Lake Placid / Whiteface Mtn. KOA Holiday
evidence: KOA June-2026 site map: Riverside section 201-259 is across NY-86 by the West Branch Ausable; Esri summer 44.3862,-73.8222 shows those rows, SE-most pads ~75-85 m from the river behind a pine belt and houses; 'Riverside' names the section

name: Cedar Point County Park
evidence: NYS leaf-off ortho 41.0405,-72.2385: camp loops (sandy pads, tables) sit inland; westernmost tables ~145 m from the Northwest Harbor beach behind park HQ, parking and wooded bluff; bay 'views' belong to glamping tents; pin moved from residential to the loops
